external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A store colleague who looks at the shifts they have been given.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given. Colleagues reach the app from their own phones.

external_entities.name: store manager
external_entities.description: Builds the weekly rota for a store.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

external_entities.name: payroll system
external_entities.description: System run by another team that collects the weekly payroll export.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.

processes.name: scheduling web app
processes.description: The app both managers and colleagues use; holds no rota data of its own.
processes.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

processes.name: scheduling service
processes.description: Reads and writes the rotas and produces the weekly payroll export.
processes.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas

data_stores.name: rota database
data_stores.description: Holds the rotas, and colleague names, contact details and stated availability.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Colleague names, contact details and stated availability are held in that database.

data_stores.name: file share
data_stores.description: Where the weekly payroll export is written and left for the payroll system to collect.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.

data_flows.name: view shifts
data_flows.description: Colleague opens the app to see their own shifts; the response rides the same interaction.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.

data_flows.name: build rota
data_flows.description: Manager builds and changes the weekly rota for their store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

data_flows.name: rota requests
data_flows.description: The app asks the service for rota reads and writes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app talks to a scheduling service.

data_flows.name: read write rotas
data_flows.description: The service reads and writes rotas and colleague details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.
data_flows.data_description: rota entries, colleague names, contact details and availability

data_flows.name: write payroll export
data_flows.description: The service writes the weekly payroll export to the share.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.

data_flows.name: collect payroll export
data_flows.description: The payroll system initiates the collection of the export from the share.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.

trust_boundaries.name: public internet
trust_boundaries.description: Where colleagues and managers sit; colleagues reach the app from their own phones.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Colleagues reach the app from their own phones.

trust_boundaries.name: internal network
trust_boundaries.description: Holds the scheduling service, the rota database and the file share, and the web app that fronts them.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The scheduling service, the rota database and the file share are on the internal network.

trust_boundaries.name: payroll team environment
trust_boundaries.description: Run by another team; the source says nothing else about it.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app is reachable from outside the internal network.
assumptions.basis: Colleagues are stated to reach it from their own phones, which the source does not place on the internal network.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app itself sits on the internal network.
assumptions.basis: The source lists the service, database and share as internal and does not place the web app anywhere; it is grouped with them for want of any stated zone of its own.
